description: operation_status=false (power off), resolving the outside_temp=999.0 open question from capture 01: it reverted to the sentinel immediately on power-off, confirming it correlates with power state (outdoor sensor only reports while the unit is running) rather than being a one-time startup lag.
notes: RESOLVED: outside_temp=999.0 correlates with power state, not a one-time post-power-on lag. Note the request body still sent operation_mode='Heating' (the last active mode, carried over unmodified) with operation_status=false -- the server accepted this and independently reset operation_mode to 'Stop' in the response, confirming operation_status and operation_mode are treated as genuinely independent fields server-side (matches climate.py's existing design: power is mapped from operation_status, not inferred from operation_mode).
